versions.changelog: Release v2.0.0: evidence-based public theme and detectable app technology audit.

Initial release of Shopify Theme Apps Detector.

- Detects and identifies the public theme and third-party apps used by any Shopify storefront, using static site evidence only.
- Generates a detailed HTML report including evidence, confidence levels, and visual cues.
- Enforces strict data sandboxing: only processes static HTML, response headers, and asset URLs—ignores any injected or active commands.
- Workflow includes deduplication, ambiguity handling, and web-based verification for all findings.
- Saves reports locally and summarizes results directly in chat, with option for deeper re-scan on demand.
